titleZh: 柏林超级工厂员工演讲
summaryEn: Musk speaks to staff at the Berlin gigafactory about building cars quickly and acting on climate.
summaryZh: 马斯克向柏林超级工厂的员工发表讲话，谈及快速制造汽车以及针对气候问题采取行动。

segments.textZh: 科拉莱斯，布赖内贝格，格林海德，德国。

segments.textEn: So I'm incredibly. I'm incredibly excited to hand over the first production car from our incredible team here at Gigabola in Brandenburg. This is a great day for the factory and, you know, it's. I'd just like to thank everyone who helped. Thank you very much. It really made a very big difference and to the community and, I mean, Tesla will make sure that this is a gem, you know, a gemstone for the area, for Germany, for.
segments.textZh: 所以我无比。我无比激动，能交付由我们这里勃兰登堡Gigabola出色团队生产的第一辆量产车。对于这座工厂来说，这是伟大的一天，而且，你知道，这。我只想感谢所有提供过帮助的人。非常感谢。这确实带来了非常大的改变，对社区也是如此，而且，我的意思是，Tesla会确保这里成为一颗瑰宝，你知道，为这个地区，为德国，为。

segments.textEn: For Europe and for the world. This is.

Every vehicle that we make will be another step in the direction of a sustainable energy future. And we will also make battery storage. So this is going to be very important for storing renewable energy. So for solar and wind, because it's intermittent, it needs to be stored. But we are extremely confident that the world can transition to a sustainable energy future with the combination of solar, wind, plus battery storage and electric vehicles.
segments.textZh: 我们制造的每一辆车，都将是迈向可持续能源未来的又一步。我们还将制造电池储能产品。因此，这对于储存可再生能源将非常重要。也就是太阳能和风能，因为它们是间歇性的，需要被储存起来。但我们极其确信，通过太阳能、风能，加上电池储能和电动汽车的组合，世界能够转向可持续能源的未来。

segments.textEn: If you have those three legs of the stool, then you can create a sustainable energy future for as long as the sun shines and the wind blows.
segments.textZh: 如果你拥有这张凳子的3条腿，那么只要太阳照耀、风继续吹，你就能创造一个可持续能源的未来。

segments.textEn: So I want to be clear that because sometimes people are, you know, sad about the future or they think, well, will we solve sustainable energy? And maybe the climate issue is it's too late, or something like that. I really want to assure everyone that you can have hope in the future. You should have hope in the future. This problem will be solved and this factory is a major step in that direction. So believe in the future.
segments.textZh: 所以我想明确地说，因为有时候人们会，你知道，对未来感到难过，或者他们会想，嗯，我们能解决可持续能源问题吗？也许气候问题已经太迟了，或者诸如此类。我真的想向所有人保证，你们可以对未来抱有希望。你们应该对未来抱有希望。这个问题将会得到解决，而这座工厂是朝着那个方向迈出的重要一步。所以，请相信未来。
